name: Tian Chang Group Holdings Ltd.
summary: Tian Chang Group Holdings Ltd., founded in 2000 and based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that supplies vaping products and plastic solutions to Hong Kong, the mainland, the US, the UK, Japan, Germany and other markets. It has three divisions: OEM e-cigarettes, plastic injection molds and parts for printers, cars and electronics, and medical consumables such as CAREWE face masks.
